title_en: Decision of the State Council on Establishing Administrative Licensing for Administrative Approval Items That Need to Be Retained

articles.content_en:
In accordance with the Administrative License Law of the People's Republic of China and the relevant provisions on the reform of the administrative examination and approval system, the State Council has conducted a comprehensive review of the administrative examination and approval items of its various departments. Administrative license items established by laws and administrative regulations shall continue to be implemented according to law; for administrative examination and approval items established by normative documents other than laws and administrative regulations, but which indeed need to be retained and comply with the matters specified in Article 12 of the Administrative License Law of the People's Republic of China, it is hereby decided, pursuant to the provisions of paragraph 2 of Article 14 of the Administrative License Law of the People's Republic of China, to retain and establish administrative licenses, totaling 500 items.
To ensure the implementation of the administrative licenses established by this Decision in accordance with law, openly, fairly, and justly, the relevant departments of the State Council shall make specific provisions on the conditions, among others, for implementing each administrative license listed in this Decision, and shall publish them. The procedures and time limits for implementing the administrative licenses shall be carried out in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Administrative License Law of the People's Republic of China.
